dav1d 1.5.1 public headers (include/dav1d, BSD-2-Clause, see COPYING), from github.com/videolan/dav1d tag 1.5.1.
version.h is generated by dav1d's build; it is written here by hand for the libdav1d.so.7 ABI. CuTePi loads
libdav1d.so.7 at run time (dlopen, gsp/av1dec), so building needs no dav1d package; the decoder element is
registered only where the library is installed (Debian: libdav1d7, already pulled in by FFmpeg).
